description: Candidate mappings for stock fundamental analysis. Mappings do not establish unit equivalence or scoring eligibility.

revenue.notes: Operating Revenue may not mean the same thing as Total Revenue for banks or other financial companies.

Yahoo Finance via yfinance: Net Income From Continuing Operation Net Minority Interest

net_income.notes: Do not treat all net income variants as interchangeable. Select a canonical definition after checking statement semantics.

operating_profit.notes: Validate the provider definition and treatment of financial companies before comparing.

earnings_per_share.notes: Basic and diluted EPS are distinct measures.

operating_margin.notes: Yahoo operatingMargins is a profile metric. Do not combine it with historical statement margins as though they share the same as-of date.

return_on_equity.notes: Current profile value only in this mapping. No historical Screener ROE series has been established here.

return_on_assets.notes: Current profile value only; not a historical point-in-time series.

price_to_earnings.notes: Trailing and forward P/E are different metrics. Keep them separate and preserve the profile retrieval date.

price_to_book.notes: Current profile value only; validate suitability for banks and companies with unusual book values.

total_debt.notes: Borrowings and provider-defined Total Debt may differ in scope. Do not equate them without validation.

total_assets.notes: Matching labels do not prove matching currency scale, consolidation basis or period semantics.

total_liabilities.notes: Confirm the provider's liability definition and minority-interest treatment.

Yahoo Finance via yfinance: Cash Flow From Continuing Operating Activities

operating_cash_flow.notes: Check annual versus quarterly flow semantics and currency scale before comparison.

free_cash_flow.notes: Provider definitions may differ. This metric may be unsuitable as a primary quality metric for banks.

gross_npa_ratio.notes: Banking-specific metric; retain as Screener-only unless a reliable equivalent is obtained.

net_npa_ratio.notes: Banking-specific metric; retain as Screener-only unless a reliable equivalent is obtained.
